title: Cinderella
moral: A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본. text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 문장 경계에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.cast:<cind|step|sis1|sis2|fairy|prince>:: 인물 자세(cind: stand·braid·cry·surprise·joy·gown·give·run·sit·hug / step: stand·point / sis: stand·proud·foot·sorry / fairy: appear·wand / prince: stand·dance·slipper)·자리·이동
acts.ribbon:pop | mice:out | horses:line | go: 놀이판 연출(리본 퐁, 생쥐가 하나씩 나와 말이 됨, 드레스 반짝, 빛나기, 나타남·사라짐)

lines.en: Once upon a time, there lived a kind-hearted girl.
segs: Once upon a time, there lived a kind-hearted girl.

lines.text: 아가씨는 새엄마와 두 언니와 함께 살았지요.
lines.en: She lived with her stepmother and her two stepsisters.
segs: She lived with her stepmother and her two stepsisters.

lines.en: In the kitchen, Stepmother spoke to the girl.
segs: In the kitchen, Stepmother spoke to the girl.

lines.en: You work in the kitchen!

lines.text: 아가씨는 날마다 아궁이 옆에서 재를 싹싹 쓸고, 바닥을 박박 닦았어요.
lines.en: Every day she swept up the ashes by the fireplace, swish, swish, and scrubbed the floor, scrub, scrub.
segs: Every day she swept up the ashes by the fireplace, swish, swish, and scrubbed the floor, scrub, scrub.

lines.en: Ashy girl! Ashy girl!
So the girl was called Cinderella.
segs: So the girl was called Cinderella.

lines.text: 어느 날, 궁전에서 무도회 편지가 왔어요.
lines.en: One day, a letter came from the palace. There was a ball!
segs: One day, a letter came from the palace. There was a ball!

lines.text: 집 안 응접실에서 두 언니가 편지를 보았어요.
lines.en: The two sisters looked at the letter in the sitting room.
segs: The two sisters looked at the letter in the sitting room.

lines.text: 언니들은 신이 나서 폴짝폴짝 뛰며 호들갑을 떨었어요.
lines.en: The sisters were so excited that they hopped and bounced and made a great big fuss.
segs: The sisters were so excited that they hopped and bounced and made a great big fuss.

lines.en: One sister called to Cinderella.

lines.text: 신데렐라, 내 머리 좀 예쁘게 해 줘!
lines.en: Cinderella, do my hair nicely!
Yes, I will make it pretty.
segs: Yes, I will make it pretty.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 언니 머리를 정성껏 땋고, 리본을 퐁 달아 주었어요.
lines.en: Cinderella braided her sister's hair ever so carefully and popped a ribbon on top. Pop!
segs: Cinderella braided her sister's hair ever so carefully and popped a ribbon on top. Pop!

lines.en: Oh, how pretty!
The sisters happily went off to the ball.
segs: The sisters happily went off to the ball.

lines.en: That night, Cinderella was all alone in the kitchen.
segs: That night, Cinderella was all alone in the kitchen.

lines.en: Cinderella, left all alone, sobbed and sobbed.
segs: Cinderella, left all alone, sobbed and sobbed.

lines.en: I wish I could go to the ball, too.
segs: I wish I could go to the ball, too.

lines.text: 그때 부엌에 환한 빛이 반짝반짝 비치더니, 누군가 사뿐 내려섰어요.
lines.en: Just then a bright light twinkled and sparkled in the kitchen, and someone floated gently down.
segs: Just then a bright light twinkled and sparkled in the kitchen, and someone floated gently down.

lines.en: Then her fairy godmother appeared.

lines.text: 울지 마렴. 너도 무도회에 가고 싶지? 내가 도와주마.
lines.en: Don't cry, dear. You want to go to the ball, don't you? I will help you.
segs: Don't cry, dear. You want to go to the ball, don't you? I will help you.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 요정 대모와 집 밖 텃밭으로 나갔어요.
lines.en: Cinderella went out to the garden with her fairy godmother.
segs: Cinderella went out to the garden with her fairy godmother.

lines.en: Bring me the biggest pumpkin from the garden.
segs: Bring me the biggest pumpkin from the garden.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 커다란 호박을 데굴데굴 굴려 왔어요.
lines.en: Cinderella rolled the big round pumpkin over, roly-poly, roly-poly.
segs: Cinderella rolled the big round pumpkin over, roly-poly, roly-poly.

lines.en: Now, one little wave of my wand!
segs: Now, one little wave of my wand!

lines.en: The pumpkin turned into a golden coach!
segs: The pumpkin turned into a golden coach!

lines.text: 텃밭의 마차 곁에서 요정 대모가 쥐덫을 살펴보았어요.
lines.en: Beside the coach in the garden, her fairy godmother looked at a mousetrap.
segs: Beside the coach in the garden, her fairy godmother looked at a mousetrap.

lines.en: There are mice in the trap.
segs: There are mice in the trap.

lines.text: 요정 대모가 지팡이로 쥐덫을 똑똑 두드렸어요.
lines.en: The fairy godmother tapped the mousetrap with her wand, knock, knock.
segs: The fairy godmother tapped the mousetrap with her wand, knock, knock.

lines.text: 생쥐가 여섯 마리! 하얀 말 여섯 마리가 되었어요.
lines.en: Six mice! They became six white horses.
segs: Six mice! They became six white horses.

lines.text: 하얀 말들이 히힝! 마차 앞에 나란히 섰어요.
lines.en: The white horses whinnied, neigh! and lined up in front of the coach.
segs: The white horses whinnied, neigh! and lined up in front of the coach.

lines.text: 큰 쥐는 마부가, 도마뱀은 시종이 되었어요.
lines.en: The big rat became the coachman, and the lizards became footmen.
segs: The big rat became the coachman, and the lizards became footmen.

lines.text: 텃밭에 선 요정 대모가 신데렐라에게 지팡이를 향했어요.
lines.en: In the garden, her fairy godmother pointed her wand at Cinderella.
segs: In the garden, her fairy godmother pointed her wand at Cinderella.

lines.en: Now it is your turn, dear.
segs: Now it is your turn, dear.

lines.text: 반짝반짝, 재 묻은 옷이 환한 빛에 포근히 감싸였어요.
lines.en: Twinkle, twinkle! Her ashy dress was wrapped up in a soft, shining light.
segs: Twinkle, twinkle! Her ashy dress was wrapped up in a soft, shining light.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 은빛 드레스에 유리 구두를 신었어요.
lines.en: Cinderella wore a silver gown and glass slippers.
segs: Cinderella wore a silver gown and glass slippers.

lines.en: Oh, thank you so much!

lines.text: 꼭 기억하렴. 밤 열두 시가 되면 마법이 풀린단다.
lines.en: Remember, dear. At midnight, the magic will end.
segs: Remember, dear. At midnight, the magic will end.

lines.en: Yes, I will remember!
Cinderella climbed into the coach.
The golden coach rattled off to the palace, clip-clop, clip-clop.
segs: The golden coach rattled off to the palace, clip-clop, clip-clop.

lines.en: Cinderella stepped into the palace ballroom.
segs: Cinderella stepped into the palace ballroom.

lines.en: When she arrived at the palace, everyone stared at Cinderella.
segs: When she arrived at the palace, everyone stared at Cinderella.

lines.en: The prince strode right over, step, step, step, and held out his hand.
segs: The prince strode right over, step, step, step, and held out his hand.

lines.en: Please, dance with me.

lines.text: 둘은 음악에 맞춰 빙글빙글, 사뿐사뿐 춤을 추었어요.
lines.en: Round and round they twirled, light as feathers, dancing to the music.
segs: Round and round they twirled, light as feathers, dancing to the music.

lines.en: Cinderella shared oranges with her sisters, too.
segs: Cinderella shared oranges with her sisters, too.

lines.en: Oh, thank you!
The sisters did not know who she was.
segs: The sisters did not know who she was.

lines.text: 시계를 보니 열두 시가 가까워요. 신데렐라는 약속대로 집에 돌아왔어요.
lines.en: The clock said it was almost midnight. Cinderella went home, just as she promised.
segs: The clock said it was almost midnight. Cinderella went home, just as she promised.

lines.en: The next night, there was another ball.
segs: The next night, there was another ball.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 다시 궁전으로 가서 왕자님과 춤을 추었어요.
lines.en: Cinderella went back to the palace and danced with the prince.
segs: Cinderella went back to the palace and danced with the prince.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 춤추느라 시간 가는 줄 몰랐어요.
lines.en: Cinderella was dancing so happily that she forgot the time.
segs: Cinderella was dancing so happily that she forgot the time.

lines.text: 그때 커다란 시계가 뎅, 뎅, 울리기 시작했어요.
lines.en: Just then the great big clock began to ring. Dong! Dong!
segs: Just then the great big clock began to ring. Dong! Dong!

lines.en: Oh no, it's twelve o'clock!

lines.text: 신데렐라는 왕자님의 손을 놓고 후다닥 달려 나갔어요.
lines.en: Cinderella let go of the prince's hand and dashed away, pitter-patter, as fast as she could.
segs: Cinderella let go of the prince's hand and dashed away, pitter-patter, as fast as she could.

lines.en: The prince called after Cinderella as she ran away.
segs: The prince called after Cinderella as she ran away.

lines.en: Wait! Please do not go!
The prince followed her out to the palace steps.
segs: The prince followed her out to the palace steps.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 계단을 달려 내려가다 유리 구두 한 짝을 떨어뜨렸어요.
lines.en: Cinderella ran down the stairs and lost one glass slipper.
segs: Cinderella ran down the stairs and lost one glass slipper.

lines.text: 열두 시가 지나자 황금 마차는 펑! 다시 호박이 되었어요.
lines.en: When midnight passed, the golden coach went poof! and turned back into a pumpkin.
segs: When midnight passed, the golden coach went poof! and turned back into a pumpkin.

lines.text: 신데렐라는 재 묻은 옷차림으로 집에 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Cinderella went home in her old, ashy clothes.
segs: Cinderella went home in her old, ashy clothes.

lines.text: 왕자님은 계단에 남은 유리 구두를 살며시 주워 들었어요.
lines.en: The prince gently picked up the glass slipper left on the stairs.
segs: The prince gently picked up the glass slipper left on the stairs.

lines.en: The slipper twinkled and sparkled in the moonlight.
segs: The slipper twinkled and sparkled in the moonlight.

lines.text: 이 구두가 꼭 맞는 사람을 찾을 거예요.
lines.en: I will find the person this slipper fits.
segs: I will find the person this slipper fits.

lines.text: 왕자님이 유리 구두를 들고 집집마다 찾아다녔어요.
lines.en: The prince carried the glass slipper from house to house.
segs: The prince carried the glass slipper from house to house.

lines.en: At last, the prince reached Cinderella’s home.
segs: At last, the prince reached Cinderella’s home.

lines.text: 응접실에서 두 언니가 구두를 신어 보겠다고 나섰어요.
lines.en: In the sitting room, both sisters stepped forward to try on the slipper.
segs: In the sitting room, both sisters stepped forward to try on the slipper.

lines.en: My foot will fit!
My foot will fit, too!

lines.text: 언니들의 발은 너무 커서 들어가지 않았어요.
lines.en: The sisters' feet were too big, and the slipper would not fit.
segs: The sisters' feet were too big, and the slipper would not fit.

lines.en: May I try it on, too?
segs: May I try it on, too?

lines.text: 언니들은 피식 코웃음을 쳤지만, 왕자님은 고개를 끄덕였어요.
lines.en: The sisters snickered, tee-hee, but the prince nodded his head.
segs: The sisters snickered, tee-hee, but the prince nodded his head.

lines.text: 왕자님이 무릎을 꿇자, 작은 발이 유리 구두에 쏙 들어갔어요.
lines.en: The prince knelt down, and her little foot slipped right into the glass slipper. Slip!
segs: The prince knelt down, and her little foot slipped right into the glass slipper. Slip!

lines.en: The slipper fit perfectly!

lines.text: 신데렐라는 주머니에서 다른 한 짝을 꺼냈어요.
lines.en: Cinderella took the other slipper out of her pocket.
segs: Cinderella took the other slipper out of her pocket.

lines.text: 모두가 모인 응접실에 요정 대모가 나타났어요.
lines.en: Her fairy godmother appeared in the sitting room where everyone had gathered.
segs: Her fairy godmother appeared in the sitting room where everyone had gathered.

lines.text: 요정 대모가 다시 고운 옷을 입혀 주었어요.
lines.en: Her fairy godmother dressed her in a beautiful gown again.
segs: Her fairy godmother dressed her in a beautiful gown again.

lines.en: The two sisters told Cinderella they were sorry.
segs: The two sisters told Cinderella they were sorry.

lines.en: Cinderella, we are sorry for all that time. We are truly sorry.
segs: Cinderella, we are sorry for all that time.

lines.en: Cinderella gave her sisters a great big hug, squeeze, squeeze.
segs: Cinderella gave her sisters a great big hug, squeeze, squeeze.

lines.en: It's all right. Let's be happy together.
segs: It's all right. Let's be happy together.

lines.en: Sisters, from now on, let us be kind to one another.
segs: Sisters, from now on, let us be kind to one another.

lines.en: Everyone laughed together.

lines.text: 착한 마음은 나를 괴롭힌 사람도 용서할 수 있어요.
lines.en: A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.
segs: A kind heart can forgive even those who were unkind to us.
